create_ctc_distribution: create a CTC distribution from log potentials and labels for CTC alignment modeling
compute_ctc_loss: compute the CTC loss from log potentials and extended labels using optax or semiring inference
compute_log_partition: compute the log partition function for CTC alignments with optional optax backend
convert_alignment_to_labels: convert a CTC alignment tensor back to predicted label sequences
compute_log_prob_labels: compute the log probability of given label sequences under the CTC model
